posts.name: Kilo Code for JetBrains
posts.tagline: Fully native, open-source coding agent built for JetBrains
posts.description: Kilo Code for JetBrains is a fully native, open-source coding agent for IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, Rider, PhpStorm, CLion, RubyMine — any JetBrains IDE. Designed for both local and remote dev, with parallel agents in isolated worktrees, GitHub PRs and diffs inline, and 500+ models.

posts.name: Computable GPU Index (CGI)
posts.tagline: The first open-source price index for GPU compute
posts.description: Computable GPU Index (CGI) is a USD price per GPU-hour, computed from the published on-demand rental rates of a fixed panel of providers. The methodology is mathematically robust, and anyone can verify and reproduce every print.

posts.name: Creatium Coach
posts.tagline: Your multimedia mentor that takes you from mid to great
posts.description: Creatium Coach is a lifelike, multimedia coach that helps anyone set goals and reach them. Instead of clicking through static courses or half-remembering a video, you learn with a coach, as well as simulations, videos, and roleplays. These boost outcomes as much as one-on-one in-person coaching. Whatever the goal, professional or personal, and whether you're one learner or a whole enterprise, Coach meets you where you are. Warning: side effects may include world domination.

posts.name: Gauth AI Course
posts.tagline: AI courses you can watch, quiz through, and create
posts.description: Gauth’s AI Course turns any subject into an interactive course, starting with 200+ AI math courses covering every US high school topic, from Algebra I through AP Calculus. The AI Course includes visuals, mindmaps, active-recall quizzes built in and enables you to pause any lesson to ask the AI Tutor a question. You can also generate your own course in seconds, to create personalized lessons at your own pace and share it with others.

posts.name: Sider Code
posts.tagline: Reshape any website with plain words via Sider extension
posts.description: For 30 years, websites set the rules. Now you do. In the Sider Chrome extension, tell Sider Code how a site you rely on should work. It understands the page, writes the code, and makes the change. You can save and control the feature.

posts.name: TrustedRouter
posts.tagline: Every model with a unified interface. Privacy with proof.
posts.description: One OpenAI-compatible API for hundreds of models on attested infrastructure, end to end encryption, with Confidential routes, ZDR routes, provider failover, BYOK, and no prompt or output logs.

posts.name: EAS Observe
posts.tagline: Performance monitoring built for Expo and React Native
posts.description: Observe measures how fast your Expo app starts and how fast each screen becomes usable, on real user devices. Install the library, wrap your root layout, and startup metrics arrive with nothing to instrument. Every native build and every EAS Update gets its own marker on the chart, so you can see which release moved the line. Full device context on every session: model, OS, country, network type, thermal state, frame data. Free plan covers 100K events a month.

posts.name: Notchling
posts.tagline: A little creature that lives in your MacBook notch
posts.description: Notchling is a tiny creature living in your MacBook notch. It watches your cursor, dozes off when you idle, feels your battery, and when you drag a file at it, it opens its mouth and carries it for you. Free, under a megabyte, and nothing leaves your Mac.

posts.name: HONOR Robot Phone
posts.tagline: The phone that literally has a gimbal built in
posts.description: HONOR Robot Phone puts a motorized 4-DoF gimbal inside a flagship Android phone. Its 200MP main camera can physically move to stabilize shots, track subjects, follow you on calls, and shoot autonomously, with ARRI LogC3 and Looks built into the imaging workflow.

posts.name: Murmell
posts.tagline: Google docs for AI agents, and you can close your laptop
posts.description: Our first Product Hunt launch brought many new users to Murmell and showed us that the infrastructure was not ready to scale. So we rebuilt it from scratch. We also created unified agent memory: close your laptop, freeze a canvas, and return to the exact same workspace, terminals, files and conversations. Your agents retain their context and continue where they stopped, while teammates can join the same live environment and collaborate in real time.

posts.name: Sourclip 2.0
posts.tagline: The research workspace built around Gemini Notebook
posts.description: Sourclip is a research workspace built around Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM). Discover and capture sources from YouTube, the web, Reddit, X, PDFs, and AI chats (ChatGPT,Claude,Gemini and more), organize research with folders and reusable prompts, import YouTube playlists and channels, edit mind maps, and turn Audio Overviews into private podcasts. Export your research as Markdown, HTML, or PDF and keep your workflow organized across projects and devices.

posts.name: ChannelOS
posts.tagline: Turn your local media library into cable-style TV
posts.description: ChannelOS is a local-first Windows TV system that turns media you already own into persistent, programmable channels. Build your own stations, give them schedules, browse a live cable-style TV Guide, watch On Demand, and switch channels from a couch-friendly interface. No account, cloud service, or media upload required. The current alpha is free and open source under MPL-2.0.

posts.name: ThunderPhone
posts.tagline: Platform for building reliable AI phone agents (from 2c/min)
posts.description: ThunderPhone is a self-serve platform for building AI phone agents. From 2¢/min with models included. Our Storm tier, with its extra-intelligence option, scores 99.4% on Big Bench Audio — eval set public on Hugging Face. Build agents, test them with AI-caller simulations, monitor and steer live calls, and get auto-detected issues with proposed fixes. 47 languages.

posts.name: Folio
posts.tagline: A read-later app sending a typeset digest to your e-reader
posts.description: I built Folio because I kept getting distracted by notifications when trying to read on my phone. Folio takes your open tabs, RSS feeds, and newsletters, and turns them into a cleanly typeset digest. You get a private email address for newsletters, and it strips out the ads and menus. Then it automatically delivers a custom PDF or EPUB directly to your reMarkable, Kindle, or Google Drive. The idea is to move your reading to an e-ink device, so you can actually focus.

posts.name: Happy Shrimp
posts.tagline: Alibaba's AI music generator for turning ideas into songs
posts.description: HappyShrimp is Alibaba's new AI music generator for creating complete songs from simple ideas. Describe a feeling, story, memory, or musical direction, and it generates the lyrics, melody, arrangement, and vocals together. Bring your own lyrics, create instrumentals, and shape the instruments, vocal style, tempo, and progression — no production experience required.

posts.name: WaseiGo
posts.tagline: Learn the 1,000+ Japanese words that only look like English
posts.description: In Japan, 'consent' (konsento) means a power outlet and a 'claim' is a complaint. WaseiGo teaches 1,000+ wasei-eigo, the English-looking words whose meanings Japan reinvented, through illustrated two-voice dialogues with native audio, a searchable dictionary, and picture quizzes. Guess first, then learn why. A free selection to start; a one-time purchase unlocks everything. No subscription.

posts.name: Keiki
posts.tagline: Build one customer-facing AI agent and launch it everywhere
posts.description: Build one customer-facing AI agent and launch it across SMS, iMessage, WhatsApp, Slack, Telegram, and email. Give it your knowledge, memory, voice, tools, and boundaries so it can answer questions, use business systems, complete work, and hand off when human judgment is needed. Keiki runs the shared infrastructure behind every channel and gives you one place to inspect conversations, approve sensitive actions, and improve the agent over time.

posts.name: Cosmic Agent Plugins
posts.tagline: Connect Cosmic agents to any service with an MCP server
posts.description: Your Cosmic Agents already manage your content. Plugins let them work in your other tools too: a vendor's official MCP server, its skills, and a token slot, installed on one agent. Real vendor tools, not guessed API calls. GitHub, Stripe, Render, PostHog, and Resend install today.

posts.name: Tovel AI
posts.tagline: From conversation to action, in three steps
posts.description: While other AI recorders focus primarily on recording, transcription, and summaries, Tovel goes further—turning conversations into real business actions that you review and approve. Through deep native integrations, Tovel can create CRM contacts, leads, opportunities, appointments, tasks, and reminders, as well as draft follow-up emails. No custom Zaps. No complicated low-code or no-code workflows. Tovel doesn’t just tell you what happened—it helps complete what happens next.

posts.name: Nodeterm
posts.tagline: A node-based free open source terminal manager
posts.description: A node-based free open source terminal manager for macOS, Linux and Windows. Real terminals and coding agents as live nodes on an infinite canvas — watch Claude, Codex and Gemini work, wire them together, and never lose a session to a reboot.

posts.name: Naseem
posts.tagline: A native AI agent that does real work on your Mac
posts.description: Naseem is a native AI agent for macOS, built entirely in Swift. It can work with your files, run terminal commands and Python, drive native Mac apps, automate and test apps in the iOS Simulator, use MCP and Skills, delegate to sub-agents, and work remotely through Telegram. Bring your own model or run locally with Ollama/MLX. Every consequential action requires your approval first, and autonomous mode is strictly opt-in. No Electron. No Node. It does real work on your Mac — with you in control.

posts.name: ARC-24 Multitrack Groovebox for iOS
posts.tagline: Multitrack synth, sampler, drum machine, and looper for iOS.
posts.description: An eight-track music studio for iPhone and iPad. Pick a key and every pad is in key. There is no wrong note to hit. Build a track from synths, drum kits, and your own samples. Record a loop, keep playing over it while it cycles, edit any note on a grid, then arrange the loops into a song. 10 drum kits. 21 synth presets. 16 sampler pads you can fill with a recording of anything. A full effects rack on every track. 7 days free, then one payment of $9.99 USD. No subscription, nothing to cancel.

posts.name: nOS4
posts.tagline: A complete IOS4 experience in your browser!
posts.description: nOS4 brings the iPhone you remember back to your browser. Play around, open some apps, play games and enjoy the nostalgia :)

posts.name: BobVault for BobCLI
posts.tagline: CLI based Zero-Knowledge Architecture for code repositories
posts.description: VaultBob brings true user sovereignty to your dev workflow. We teamed up with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to build a NEW end-to-end Zero-Knowledge Architecture for code repositories.  Unlike GitHub or other platforms that hold your keys, VaultBob encrypts your source code, configuration files, and deep local AI context directly on your machine before upload. Your encryption key never leaves your device. Secure, versioned snapshots with zero third-party risk. #PowerToTheUser 🌲

posts.name: Corlen
posts.tagline: AI virtual try-on for online fashion stores
posts.description: Corlen lets your customers see themselves in any outfit in few seconds. Virtual try-on for Shopify, WooCommerce, and in-store kiosks. Photos deleted in 2 hours always.

posts.name: Matrix OS
posts.tagline: A cloud computer for you and your agents
posts.description: Matrix OS gives you and your AI agents a persistent computer in the cloud. Run Claude Code, Codex and other agents without tying them to your laptop. Keep your files, repos, terminals and apps running, close your laptop, and come back from any device. Run multiple agents in parallel, or self-host Matrix for full control.

posts.name: HackrBio
posts.tagline: Everything you’ve shipped on one link.
posts.description: A portfolio for indie hackers, developers and founders. Projects, repos, writing, products and links on one page. One payment, everything included. 7 Day free trial.

posts.name: Peanut Split
posts.tagline: Split a bill with a link. No account for anyone.
posts.description: Peanut Split is a bill splitter for a group trip or a shared flat. Nobody makes an account. Set up a room with everyone's names in it and drop the link in the group chat. Each person taps their name and types what they paid.

posts.name: Atelier
posts.tagline: The AI workspace for interior designers
posts.description: Atelier is an AI-native workspace for interior designers and studios. Build pinboards and presentations, turn selected products into FF&E schedules, manage procurement and client approvals, track time by project, phase and task, and create proposals and invoices. AI can organise project information, bring in product and quote details, compare them with plans, and flag missing or conflicting information. Designers keep control of their taste, product choices and final decisions.

posts.name: PicVore
posts.tagline: Swipe through photos. On-device AI finds the best shots.
posts.description: Clear your iPhone photo library without second-guessing. Swipe photos one by one, compare similar shots side by side, and let PicVore suggest a Best Pick on-device. Review by album, date, category, or place. Nothing is deleted until you confirm, and your photo analysis stays on your device.

posts.name: UseAgent
posts.tagline: UseAgent is an open source AI coworker. Gets your work done.
posts.description: UseAgent is an open source coworker for your whole company. It researches, writes, analyzes, creates files, and runs code to finish multi-step work across support, sales, marketing, engineering, and ops. Use it from Slack or the web, switch engines (Codex, Claude, OpenCode, Pi), and stay in control with approval gates. Self-host or use our cloud (coming soon). It compounds: reusable playbooks, memory, skills, automations. it learns how your company works instead of resetting every session.

posts.name: Highlander
posts.tagline: Cheapest Realtime Video Generation with Minimax FastH3
posts.description: The cheapest way to generate real-time 768p AI video. We were inspired by infiniteslop.ai by @levelsio and tried rebuilding it but could not find cheap alternatives. Instead, we built custom GPU kernels to get the best price to performance ratio. We serve MiniMax H3 Fast at 50% of the cost of competitors. This product is ideal for people looking to build realtime video applications!

posts.name: Make me a Gift
posts.tagline: Create your wishlist, and share it with friends and family.
posts.description: Surprises are wonderful... but what if you don't like them? Create your wishlist, add what you truly want and share it with friends and family. They no longer have to rack their brains, and you won't be disappointed.

posts.name: Hey-Traders Live Trading
posts.tagline: Describe, backtest, and automate your trading strategy
posts.description: Any trading strategy in mind? Tell Hetty how it should enter, exit, size positions, manage risk, and choose between markets. Backtest it, then run it in paper or live mode. Build the strategy you have in mind—from momentum, mean-reversion, grid, and DCA to pair, cross-sectional, and multi-market systems that rank and rebalance up to 20 markets across exchanges. Run it on Binance, Hyperliquid, Lighter, Extended, and Polymarket Perps, with performance, positions, and orders in one workspace.

posts.name: PixoMonitor
posts.tagline: Uptime monitoring that knows before your users do
posts.description: PixoMonitor watches websites, APIs, servers, cron jobs, and user journeys from multiple locations. Get alerts, manage incidents, and publish branded status pages from one platform. Start free with no credit card.

posts.name: PexarBolt Ultra TBT5 Dock
posts.tagline: The First Thunderbolt5 Control Dock that Shows Your Workflow
posts.description: PexarBolt is a Thunderbolt 5 dock that does what no dock can: it shows you what it's doing — and lets you answer. Normally you find out something's wrong when your monitor blinks, a transfer crawls, or your laptop quietly stops charging. A built-in 5-inch touchscreen surfaces the invisible half of your workflow —— transfers, power, temperature, network, warnings, AI status — and lets you act on it. Tap to approve a Claude Code/ Codex session or switch the view, without ever leaving your work.

posts.name: Skrivla Editor
posts.tagline: Write together with anyone and bring your own AI
posts.description: Skrivla is where people and AI write together. It's like a minimal Google Docs or Notion where you can easily bring your own AI. Perfect for quick brainstorming sessions, feature specs, meeting notes, and more.

posts.name: INKROOST
posts.tagline: Draw your story or bring it life with AI
posts.description: Inkroost is where indie comics, webtoons and manga are made and read. Publish your own pages, or turn a story into comic pages with optional but powerful AI tools, then read free chapters and support independent creators directly via their Patreon accounts.

posts.name: AskAiRank
posts.tagline: Track how ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini talk about your brand
posts.description: AskRank shows how AI assistants see your brand. It runs your customers' real questions through ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and more, then tracks whether you're mentioned, how you rank against competitors, and which sources the AI cites. You get alerts when visibility drops, a citation gap report, and clear actions to win more AI answers. Built for SaaS founders and marketers whose next customers are already asking AI instead of Google.

posts.name: Periscope
posts.tagline: Turn your Apple TV into your own private internet tunnel
posts.description: What's new: an Apple TV can now be the always-on server. The device already in your living room becomes the thing your phone and laptop connect back to, so nothing else has to stay switched on. Periscope routes you through your own home rather than a VPN company's servers, so you browse on your real home IP — fewer bank fraud flags, home-country streaming that works, none of the captchas commercial VPN IPs trigger. WireGuard under the hood. No record of what you connect to.

posts.name: Overtitle
posts.tagline: Floating, auto-synced subtitles for the Apple TV app
posts.description: Overtitle floats your own subtitle file (.srt/.vtt) over the macOS Apple TV app — locked to the real playback position, even in native full screen. Pause, seek, or buffer and the words stay on the picture. It never touches DRM; your files never leave your Mac. Bilingual cues for language learners, auto-picks episodes by filename. One-time $24, free trial included.

posts.name: Doberman
posts.tagline: The guard dog to stop your AI when it goes rogue.
posts.description: Doberman is an open-source, runtime security layer for AI coding agents. It sits between the agent and its tools and gives every action a PASS, AUTH or BLOCK verdict before it runs. A deterministic core catches known dangerous behavior, while an adaptive layer learns what’s normal for you and raises risk when something looks off. It fails closed and learning is raise-only. Works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw and MCP clients like Cursor.

posts.name: Lovspark
posts.tagline: From floor plan to client-ready render — one AI canvas
posts.description: Lovspark connects the full interior design workflow on one AI canvas. Generate concepts from photos, floor plans, or sketches; refine furniture, materials, and lighting by pointing at them; place real catalog products; export FF&E schedules and client-ready visuals — without leaving the canvas. Designed for designers who iterate. Not a one-shot pretty image — AI you control.

posts.name: LibreDB Studio
posts.tagline: SelfHosted OpenSource SQL IDE that deploys next to your data
posts.description: LibreDB Studio is the open-source database IDE that deploys next to your data instead of onto your laptop, one browser tab for PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and thirteen more engines. No tunnelling from a laptop into production, no handing credentials to a cloud service. Run it with one docker run, one Helm chart, or npx. SSO, audit trail, ER diagrams and AI-assisted queries are all MIT licensed, with nothing behind an enterprise wall. Live demo, no install: app.libredb.org

posts.name: ArcProof
posts.tagline: Verify your job-ready skills with AI in 60 seconds
posts.description: Most certificates prove you finished a course, not that you can do the work. ArcProof scans your skills, shows your gaps, and issues an independent, evidence-based credential (W3C Open Badge) that employers can verify themselves. Free scan, no signup. Follow to get notified at launch; early followers get founding-member pricing.

posts.name: inboxes.net
posts.tagline: Open-source, multi-domain inbox and agent MCP for Resend
posts.description: Resend gives you an API. inboxes gives you the inbox. Paste your API key, import your full email history, and get a real client for every domain - threads, search, undo send, scheduled send, snooze, rules, labels, and Gmail-style shortcuts. Tracking pixels and stripped by default. There's an MCP server, so your agent/harness of choice can read and draft your mail (sending is a permission toggle). $5/mo per org, unlimited members - or self-host free.

posts.name: Fyrbolt
posts.tagline: Weather
posts.description: Fyrbolt shows you the current weather and a simple weekly forecast — clean, minimal, and easy to read. Free on Android and in your browser.

posts.name: Clypy
posts.tagline: The universal clipboard for you and your AI agents
posts.description: Clypy is the universal, end-to-end encrypted clipboard for Mac, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android and your AI agents. Search by meaning, use optional local AI, and give Codex, Claude, and other MCP clients private, durable memory.

posts.name: Banavo
posts.tagline: Get your products recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini & Claude
posts.description: Shoppers ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude what to buy — and AI quietly decides which products get recommended. Most brands can't see how they show up, or why a competitor wins instead. Banavo is the GEO/AEO platform for ecommerce. It tests hundreds of real buyer prompts across every major AI assistant, scores your AI visibility, then enriches your product data, PDP content and structured data until AI knows, likes and recommends you. See your AI Promoter Score free — no signup.

posts.name: Galatrix
posts.tagline: Build worlds. Play together.
posts.description: Galatrix is a web-native game engine and multiplayer platform. A full 3D editor in the browser — scripting, physics, navigation, animation, terrain.

posts.name: VibeSEO
posts.tagline: AI SEO agent that publishes to your site, after you approve
posts.description: An AI SEO agent for small websites, with the approve button left in your hands. VibeSEO reads your site, finds what your customers search for, and drafts SEO-ready pages: title, meta, headings, FAQ, internal links, CTA. You approve what fits your brand. Approved pages publish on your own domain as crawlable URLs, sitemaps and all — your SEO authority, not ours. Then it tracks indexing, impressions and rankings. Use it in the browser, in WordPress or Framer, or from ChatGPT and Claude.

posts.name: Open Run
posts.tagline: schedule coding agents on your machine
posts.description: Schedule Claude Code, Codex, Grok and Gemini like cron jobs on your machine. Open Run drives the claude, codex, grok and gemini CLIs you already use.

posts.name: Travel With Me
posts.tagline: Put your brand on a postcard travelling through Italy
posts.description: Ten brands on one physical card, photographed throughout a week in Italy.From 4-10 September, I’m travelling through Italy with my family and taking one physical postcard with me. Ten brands can claim a spot through a live auction. I’ll print the winning logos on the card, photograph it around Lake Garda, and share the photos on X. Bids start at €5 and close on 1 September

posts.name: PhotonDrop: Air-Gapped Transfer
posts.tagline: Send files & secure keys via light. 100% offline.
posts.description: PhotonDrop enables 100% offline, air-gapped data transfer using light. Send photos, texts, or crypto keys to a completely isolated device without Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or cables. Files are mathematically sliced and streamed as high-speed animated QR codes on your screen. The receiving camera records the flashes and instantly rebuilds the file using Fountain Codes. Ideal for cybersecurity, offline crypto cold wallets, and transferring sensitive documents in zero-network environments.

posts.name: MILO
posts.tagline: Your local-first library of PM resources, no cloud, no login
posts.description: MILO (Methods, Instructions, Learning & Operations) is a local-first resource hub for product managers. Collect prompts, skills, tools, books, videos, conferences, training, articles, and podcasts as files on your machine, no account, no cloud. Share via any synced folder or bundle URL. Private by design, open and portable.

posts.name: DJ INDEX
posts.tagline: The global DJ ranking, by Spotify monthly listeners
posts.description: DJ INDEX ranks 4,400+ electronic acts every week by one honest number: monthly Spotify listeners. Global, by country, by genre. Compare any two head-to-head, see who's breaking out, and read the data report on the whole scene. No politics, no promoter votes.

posts.name: Solos Music
posts.tagline: AI music generator with multitrack stems & full song control
posts.description: Create amazing music with AI. Generate songs, remix, extend, and more with Solos Music. Solos turns simple text prompts into production ready, studio quality tracks in seconds. Built for creators, producers, and artists generate complete arrangements, isolate multi track stems, and customize genres, moods, and lyrics directly in your browser. Export lossless audio instantly.

posts.name: Foxlit
posts.tagline: A reading tracker that grows a forest as you read
posts.description: Foxlit is a reading habit tracker built around a simple loop: read, time your session, add a quick note. A daily streak keeps you consistent, and your reading time grows a tree - canopy fills in with the real covers of books you finish. Set weekly/monthly goals and track pages-per-minute over time. Free to start, one-time $4.99 unlock for the full experience - no subscription.

posts.name: AwakenQ
posts.tagline: The gamified smart alarm that actually gets you out of bed
posts.description: AwakenQ is a next-generation smart alarm clock engineered to break snooze autopilot and defeat sleep inertia. It replaces standard alarms with randomized cognitive missions (math, memory tiles), physical movement challenges (shake, scan), loss-aversion streaks, and a Tamagotchi-style Bear Mascot that grows with your wake-up consistency. Free on Android with zero paywalls.

posts.name: HeyGen Bulk Downloader
posts.tagline: Download your entire HeyGen video library in one click
posts.description: Stop downloading HeyGen videos one by one. Connect your account and download your entire video library automatically in one click, organized into a dated folder. Built for agencies, marketing teams and creators managing large libraries.

posts.name: DueTrail
posts.tagline: Get overdue B2B invoices paid and politely, on autopilot
posts.description: DueTrail chases overdue B2B invoices for you: polite, escalating reminders, a client payment portal, and live sync with Xero, QuickBooks & Moneybird so paid invoices are never chased again. Flat pricing, set up in minutes — try the demo without signing up.

posts.name: HeyGen Bulk Downloader
posts.tagline: Download your entire HeyGen video library in one click
posts.description: Stop downloading HeyGen videos one by one. Connect your account and download your entire video library automatically in one click, organized into a dated folder. Built for agencies, marketing teams and creators managing large libraries.

posts.name: Mantyl
posts.tagline: Hand over AI-built software with proof
posts.description: Mantyl compiles your repository, your coding-agent history and executed checks into a verified project passport your client can independently re-run. Every claim is labelled by who proved it. Free local-first CLI for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. No account.

posts.name: Bubfloat
posts.tagline: Pay to stay afloat. Ad space that pops.
posts.description: A live board of floating bubbles. Each one is a paying app. Pick a size and a number of days; your bubble drifts, carries your logo, links to your site, shrinks as it ages, then pops publicly and frees its space. Flat day rate. No bidding, no ranking. $5 min

posts.name: Source LM
posts.tagline: Bulk sources into NotebookLM, straight from the browser
posts.description: NotebookLM takes sources one at a time, through a file picker. Source LM takes the batch: a JSON export becomes Markdown files packed under the 500k-word source cap, a YouTube playlist becomes one source per video. No downloads, no backend, no account. The extension ships unminified and the source is public — "no backend" is a claim you can check, not trust.

posts.name: Hybrix IOS APP
posts.tagline: Chat with Greatest Minds. Build and own your AI agents.
posts.description: Users can chat, brainstorm, voice call, video call, and bring agents into group chats with friends. This launch combines persona-inspired voices with an AI-native social feed, community posts, paid gigs, and tools to build, train, publish, and own customizable agents as digital assets—all inside one connected platform.

posts.name: ElonBid.lol
posts.tagline: Put your logo on Elon Musk, Starship, and Tesla Cybercab
posts.description: Put your logo on live 3D models of Elon Musk, SpaceX Starship, and Tesla Cybercab. Bid for premier spots, outbid competitors in real-time, get genuine click traffic, and broadcast your brand to thousands of daily tech enthusiasts.

posts.name: MatchoCV
posts.tagline: Tailor your CV to one job posting without inventing anything
posts.description: Tailor your CV to one job posting without inventing anything. MatchoCV rewrites the wording, ordering and emphasis for that role, cites the line behind every change, and exports PDF or DOCX. The Chrome extension starts a run from the posting you are reading.

posts.name: Chaosword
posts.tagline: Three fresh crosswords a day. Fair grids, sharp clues.
posts.description: A daily crossword trilogy: a 5x5 warmup, a 7x7 standard, and an 11x11 capstone, published together every evening. Same grids for everyone. Always fair, always solvable. Clues run from straight definitions to pure wordplay. Race the board, share your time. Free, no account. Every day has randomized features / mechanic twists to keep things fresh.

posts.name: Nibunam AI
posts.tagline: Marketing brain for modern business
posts.description: Nibunam gives you four AI marketing agents, each with one job. Market IQ researches your market and competitors. Ad IQ plans & strategize your ad campaigns. Search IQ helps you found on Google search/LLMs like chatgpt. Social IQ builds your social content. Built for solopreneurs, small businesses, and marketing agencies that know marketing matters but don't have hours for it. Sign up and get 3 free reports — no credit card required. Plans from $49/month. Launching Sep 1, 2026.

posts.name: Virmii
posts.tagline: Turn one character image into a live 3D VTuber
posts.description: Virmii turns a single character image into a rigged 3D VTuber you can use directly in your browser. Generate and manage a portable VRM, preview it online, drive head movement, gaze, blinks, mouth shapes, and expressions with your camera, then send a private transparent stage to OBS. No desktop avatar app or virtual camera driver is required, and each model’s tracking capability is clearly labeled.

posts.name: Buki
posts.tagline: Turn children’s drawings into private keepsake books
posts.description: Buki turns paper drawings into private digital sketchpads that still feel like little books. Adults can scan or import artwork, keep the original photo, add titles, dates, notes, tags, favorites, and voice memories, then browse every page together. Artwork saves locally first, children never need accounts, and there is no public gallery. Free includes 1 child, 1 sketchpad, and 20 artworks. Pro adds unlimited collections, private backup, premium organization, and exports.

posts.name: Melaya Browser Control + Extension
posts.tagline: Let any AI drive your browser. You watch and approve.
posts.description: Let AI agents drive a real browser you watch, approve, and stop. Two ways in: launch a dedicated Chrome, Edge, or Brave profile via the Melaya runner, or add the extension and attach one tab in your own browser, cloud-driven, no runner. Run any model, including open-weight local ones through Ollama or LM Studio, private with no per-message limits. Every action streams live, site allowlists and signed single-use grants keep it scoped, and it stops for approval before anything that matters.

posts.name: CardGo.AI
posts.tagline: Reusable context cards for AI chats, end-to-end encrypted
posts.description: Save your context once as encrypted cards, then attach the right one in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity or Grok with the CardGo Chrome extension. Free to start.

posts.name: easynotifyforward
posts.tagline: Forward Android notifications, SMS & missed calls anywhere
posts.description: Hi hunters 👋 NotifyForward forwards your Android notifications, SMS, and missed calls to where you actually look — Bark, Email, or Webhook. Why another forwarding app? • Three channels out of the box (Bark / SMTP email / Webhook) • Privacy-first: config stays on-device (DataStore), secrets in Android Keystore (AES-256-GCM). No vendor server, no account. • App allow/block list so you only forward what matters. • 8 languages. Missed-call forwarding needs no phone permission.

posts.name: Open Portal
posts.tagline: Box anything on your screen. Ask it, or make something.
posts.description: One keystroke freezes your screen. Draw a box around anything, then ask about it or say what to make. Answers arrive where you drew the box. Thumbnails, ads and redesigns come back as finished 2K images. Try both free in your browser. Mac and Windows.

posts.name: GrokIndex.dev
posts.tagline: The directory of custom Grok bots
posts.description: GrokIndex is a free directory of custom Grok bots. Browse 200+ creator-made bots by category, see what's newly listed or most viewed, and list your own in minutes. No account required. Independent, not affiliated with xAI.

posts.name: DroneWise
posts.tagline: Know if you can fly before takeoff
posts.description: Drone weather, airspace map and flight readiness. Precise forecasts, alerts and airspace in one app for iOS and Android.DroneWise is a pre-flight app for drone pilots. Check weather, wind and gusts, airspace, NOTAMs and your drone's limits in one place. Get a simple Good to Fly, Caution or Don't Fly verdict for your location and aircraft. Available on iOS and Android. Try DroneWise Pro free for 7 days.

posts.name: dropIQ
posts.tagline: Score your store as a first-time visitor vs a repeat buyer
posts.description: Every CRO tool audits your store against the same checklist. dropIQ audits it as the customer you're actually trying to reach. Run it as a first-time visitor, a repeat buyer, or a gift shopper, and see where their experiences diverge. Free audit, no login.

posts.name: ASOon
posts.tagline: 3 App Store moves a week, each graded 14 days later
posts.description: ASOon reads your own App Store data — true keyword ranks, reviews, competitors, downloads — and picks the 3 highest-leverage moves to make this week. Mark one done and it's graded 14 days later from your real rank history. iOS only. Free to start.

posts.name: ASOon
posts.tagline: 3 App Store moves a week, each graded 14 days later
posts.description: ASOon reads your own App Store data — true keyword ranks, reviews, competitors, downloads — and picks the 3 highest-leverage moves to make this week. Mark one done and it's graded 14 days later from your real rank history. iOS only. Free to start.

posts.name: Source
posts.tagline: Attribution sucks. See the customers hiding in Direct
posts.description: One pixel connects every visit, meeting, and closed deal. You see which channels produce customers, not just clicks. You can see which customers came from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or Gemini, and which ones actually typed your URL. Tied to the person and the deal, not the session. One pixel across ads, CRM, and your calendar / scheduling apps. No warehouse. SOC2 & ISO compliant.

posts.name: The Horror Codex
posts.tagline: Every horror film ever made, properly sorted.
posts.description: A comprehensive, searchable horror film database — built with AI, guided by an editor, refined by a community of horror fanatics. 65,000+ films, all sorted into specific sub genres like vampires, folk horror, or creature attacks. Rate by quality and intensity, dim what you've already seen, filter by streaming, and more.

posts.name: FundingPath.ai
posts.tagline: Commercialize, Capitalize, & Operate Any Business Idea.
posts.description: One platform that replaces dozens: a guided roadmap, AI teammates for every domain, tools to build what funders actually want (business plans, pitch decks, financial models, data rooms, CRM, Bookkeeping, Knowledge Base, Project Management, Sales Engagement, Investor Matching, Business Registration, Design Studio, Cap Table Management), and a full OS all free. Most tools help you do one thing. FundingPath helps you become fundable, operational, and grow from raw idea to funded company and beyond.

posts.name: Junco
posts.tagline: Turn newsletters into your daily podcast
posts.description: Junco is an iPhone app that turns email newsletters and RSS feeds into short, podcast-style episodes for the parts of your day when reading does not fit. Connect Gmail with read-only access or forward newsletters to a private Junco inbox, choose your sources, and listen with a queue, background playback, lock-screen controls, and offline support. Narration can run on-device on supported iPhones. Discover includes 100+ hand-picked newsletters.

posts.name: Seminara Agentic Suite
posts.tagline: Now your AI agents can present your slide decks for you
posts.description: Instruct your favorite AI agent to upload a PDF, provision a knowledge base, and autonomously launch a live, voice-led interactive presentation room for you using Seminara. The new Agentic Suite exposes full control to agents and developers via WebMCP, CLI, and multi-language SDKs.

posts.name: RefreshQueue
posts.tagline: Monday decaying-page queue from Google Search Console
posts.description: SEO agencies already export Search Console. They still don't have a Monday morning queue ranked by absolute lost clicks (not percent, not estimated traffic). RefreshQueue connects read-only GSC, tags each URL (impressions held / collapsed / CTR-only), and emails a half-page refresh brief on the top pages. We never publish to the live site. $49/mo one property, $278/mo ten.

posts.name: Sessionography - Discography Reimagined
posts.tagline: A Better Way to Explore and Listen to Jazz
posts.description: Sessionography is jazz discography as you have never seen it • See any artist's full career as leader and sideman — every date, in true session order • Full personnel on every album — tap any name to explore their career • Everything is linked: albums, labels, recording sessions, even the tunes themselves • Pick two musicians and see everything they ever recorded together • Interactive player orbit graph

posts.name: KeyRunner 2.0
posts.tagline: Build APIs and turn them into AI tools to run them securely
posts.description: KeyRunner 2.0 goes beyond API testing. Teams can now turn tested APIs into tools for AI agents, connect them through MCP or SDK, and run them securely with credentials, policies, approvals, redaction, and observability built in. It brings API development and agent execution into one workflow, without exposing production secrets to the agent.

posts.name: ihatereading.lol
posts.tagline: Your brand keyboard key on that key for a unlimited time.
posts.description: ihatereading.lol is a public Magic Keyboard where every key is a billboard. Press or click a key, paste your website, preview it, and pay $5 to hold that slot for 30 days. Newest brand on a key shows first. No accounts, no feed, no algorithm. Visitors type, click, and land on your site with a referral so you can see the traffic came from here.

posts.name: Nexara
posts.tagline: AI voice agent that eliminates bank call center wait times
posts.description: Banks receive 1,500+ calls daily. Customers wait 5-10 minutes for simple queries — balance, card issues, account information. Nexara is an AI voice agent that eliminates this completely. Customers speak naturally in English or Urdu. Nexara verifies identity, retrieves real-time account data via bank APIs, and responds verbally — all within seconds. No hold music. No queue. No frustration. 24/7 availability. For banks: on-premise deployment, read-only access, full data sovereignty.

posts.name: InfoTik
posts.tagline: Fact-checked news + AI-curated reels, now with Brain Battles
posts.description: InfoTik is back with major upgrades since our last launch: • PULSE — fact-checked news, claims linked to verified sources. • TIKS — AI-curated educational reels with auto-captions. • Brain Battles — gamified screen-time duels; friends compete on real usage minutes, loser surrenders phone time. • App-Block — snoozable, psychology-based controls. • AI-driven feed tuned to your interests. • Leaderboard, chat & creator payouts. Built by a small university-student team. iOS + Android. Free.

posts.name: bestmodels.dev
posts.tagline: Weekly ranked picks for Vercel AI Gateway models
posts.description: bestmodels.dev ranks Vercel AI Gateway models every week from the live catalog, 7-day adoption, and DeepsecBench. Open it for this week's value and frontier picks, with a ZDR + no-training badge on the route that actually qualifies. Independent, open source, and free. Privacy and open lanes stay separate. Methodology is public. JSON and weekly archives are on the site.

posts.name: Qoory
posts.tagline: Intelligence engine for crypto and stock markets
posts.description: Qoory is a live intelligence platform for crypto and stock markets. It brings together breaking news, social activity, hot searches, market data, entity relationships, and emerging narratives to surface the signals behind market moves. Explore what’s trending, track projects and people, compare assets, ask research questions, and generate cited reports—all in one place.

posts.name: Grain Studio
posts.tagline: Make tactile image textures in your browser for Free.
posts.description: For designers, illustrators, and indie creators who want richer visual texture without sending source files to a cloud editor, Grain Studio turns a browser tab into a local image texture workbench with 25 tactile effects, controllable materials, and export-ready output.

posts.name: BountyHunty
posts.tagline: Create bounties to get people posting about you on X
posts.description: Post a cash bounty and specific text for people to post on X. One entrant is randomly picked to win the prize. Dead simple, no login required. Built for launches. Get real people talking about your product instead of paying for ads or hoping for organic reach.

posts.name: PorThorOS
posts.tagline: The POS for Thailand’s medical cannabis dispensaries
posts.description: PorThorOS connects Cannabox MD prescriptions, checkout, stock, and PT27/PT28 records for licensed dispensaries in Thailand.

posts.name: Notificator Project
posts.tagline: Your website, finally speaking up.
posts.description: Turn meaningful WordPress, Strapi and Astro events into real-time push notifications, email alerts, MQTT messages, and more.

posts.name: ken
posts.tagline: Make your AI agent think first and rewrite over patch
posts.description: Ken Thompson wrote Unix in three weeks by thinking first, stealing proven ideas, building bottom-up, and rewriting anything that fought back. ken puts that discipline inside your AI agent: think first, reuse over invent, brute force until measured, rewrite over a fourth patch. It ships as a plugin for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Codex and any AGENTS.md agent and it’s benchmarked on behavior, not lines of code. Every rule traces back to Thompson’s own words.

posts.name: Browser for AI Agent
posts.tagline: Connect your browser and AI agents—in both directions
posts.description: Browser for AI Agent is an open-source bridge between your browser and AI coding agents. Let any MCP- or CLI-capable agent read tabs, control the browser, run page tools, inspect errors, and take screenshots—all through a local native host. Or bring Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and pi directly into DevTools or the browser side panel via ACP. Your browser data stays local and is shared only with the agents you configure.
